name: Build ARMv7 (Bookworm + Debian Package)

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - crossbuild
      - develop

jobs:
  build-armv7:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    container:
      image: debian:bookworm

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install ARMv7 (armhf) toolchain & packaging tools
        run: |
          dpkg --add-architecture armhf
          apt-get update
          apt-get install -y \
            build-essential \
            gcc-arm-linux-gnueabihf libc6-dev-armhf-cross \
            crossbuild-essential-armhf \
            pkg-config \
            fakeroot \
            dpkg-dev \
            gettext \
            libcrypt-dev:armhf \
            libcrypt1:armhf

      - name: Build wiringPi (ARMv7)
        run: |
          export CC=arm-linux-gnueabihf-gcc
          export AR=arm-linux-gnueabihf-ar
          export STRIP=arm-linux-gnueabihf-strip
          export CFLAGS="-v"
          export LDFLAGS="-v"

          echo "=== COMPILER SEARCH DIRS ==="
          $CC -print-search-dirs

          echo "Building wiringPi..."
          cd wiringPi
          make -j$(nproc) V=1

          echo "Building devLib..."
          cd ../devLib
          make -j$(nproc) V=1 \
            INCLUDE='-I. -I../wiringPi' \
            LDFLAGS='-L../debian-template/wiringPi/usr/lib'

          echo "Building gpio..."
          cd ../gpio
          make -j$(nproc) V=1 \
            INCLUDE='-I. -I../wiringPi -I../devLib' \
            LDFLAGS='-L../debian-template/wiringPi/usr/lib' \
            LIBS='../wiringPi/*.o ../devLib/*.o -lpthread -lrt -lm -lcrypt'

      - name: Build Debian package
        run: |
          export CC=arm-linux-gnueabihf-gcc
          export AR=arm-linux-gnueabihf-ar
          export STRIP=arm-linux-gnueabihf-strip

          vMaj=$(cut -d. -f1 VERSION)
          vMin=$(cut -d. -f2 VERSION)
          export VERSION="$vMaj.$vMin"
          # dpkg arch stays armhf; ARMv7 baseline (Pi 2-5, Zero 2).
          # Pi 1/Zero (ARMv6) are built manually - see #448/#450.
          export ARCH="armhf"

          here=$(pwd)
          deb_destdir="${here}/debian-template/wiringPi"

          echo "VERSION=$VERSION"
          echo "ARCH=$ARCH"

          cd debian-template/wiringPi
          envsubst < control_template > DEBIAN/control
          rm -rf usr

          cd "$here/wiringPi"
          make install-deb DEB_DESTDIR="${deb_destdir}"

          cd "$here/devLib"
          make install-deb INCLUDE='-I. -I../wiringPi' DEB_DESTDIR="${deb_destdir}"

          cd "$here/gpio"
          make install-deb INCLUDE='-I../wiringPi -I../devLib' \
            LDFLAGS=-L../debian-template/wiringPi/usr/lib \
            DEB_DESTDIR="${deb_destdir}"

          cd "$here/debian-template"
          fakeroot dpkg-deb --build wiringPi
          dpkg-name -o wiringPi.deb
          # distinct filename so it is not confused with the manual ARMv6 armhf build
          for f in wiringpi_*_armhf.deb; do [ -e "$f" ] && mv "$f" "${f%_armhf.deb}_armv7.deb"; done

      - name: Upload Debian package
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: wiringPi-armv7-deb
          path: debian-template/*.deb

      - name: Generate SHA256 checksum
        run: |
          cd debian-template
          sha256sum *.deb > SHA256SUMS-armv7

      - name: Upload SHA256 checksum
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: wiringPi-armv7-sha256
          path:

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
